authors: Marco Baldovin and Alessandro Manacorda
abstract:
Author(s): Marco Baldovin and Alessandro Manacorda

The objective is to find time-dependent control protocols steering the system between assigned end states, in a prescribed time interval. Under suitable assumptions, the authors find analytical solutions that are tested against simulations and provide insightful intuition.

authors: Eamon Dwight and D. Candela
abstract:
Author(s): Eamon Dwight and D. Candela

This manuscript investigates static waveform memory in a system of jammed, soft, frictional particles. It is shown that a small, time-dependent shear strain applied during progressive compression can imprint an arbitrary waveform, which is recalled in time-reversed order upon decompression. The conditions that allow memory formation and the limits of memory readout are established.
